steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: WiFi module harness
steps.body: Verify connector between WiFi module and main PBA. Reseat harness; inspect for faulty soldering on module.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify connector between WiFi module and main PBA. Reseat harness; inspect for faulty soldering on module.

steps.title: AC4 cleared?
steps.body: After harness repair and power cycle, does AC4 clear?
steps.sourceExcerpt: After harness repair and power cycle, does AC4 clear?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace WiFi module or main PBA.

steps.title: Replace WiFi module
steps.oemOutcome: Replace WiFi module when harness intact but AC4 persists.
